🌿 Welcome to Holy Moments 🕊️

A peaceful place to slow down, worship, pray, and simply rest in the presence of God.

At *Holy Moments*, you’ll find gentle worship music, peaceful piano melodies, soaking worship, and calming instrumental sounds created to help you draw closer to Jesus. Whether you’re spending time in prayer, reading Scripture, resting, studying, sleeping, or seeking peace after a long day, may these moments lead your heart back to God.

✨ Rest in His presence.
🙏 Be still and pray.
🕊️ Let His peace fill your heart.
❤️ Draw near to Jesus.

*"Be still, and know that I am God." — Psalm 46:10*

Subscribe to Holy Moments and make space each day for a quiet moment with God.

Holy Moments — Peaceful Worship. Quiet Hearts. His Presence. 🕊️🌿

snippet.description:
Selah Psalms — Sacred Pauses. Sung Psalms.

For those who pray over their home. Who fall asleep to Scripture. 
Who let the ancient psalms carry them through quiet hours.

We sing the King James Psalms as written for over 400 years — 
not paraphrased, not modernized. Every word from the 1611 Bible, 
set to soft harp and strings, sung with reverence.

✦ Peace in Psalm 23
✦ Protection in Psalm 91  
✦ Blessing for your home in Psalm 127
✦ Rest in Psalm 4
✦ Praise in Psalm 100

🎵 New psalm worship videos every week
📖 KJV verbatim — nothing added, nothing taken away
🌿 Featuring imagery of young Shepherd David, the original psalmist

⚠️ AI-assisted music production. Lyrics (KJV public domain), 
Scripture selection, and creative direction by human creators.

Subscribe for authentic King James Psalms each week.

snippet.description:
When your mind won't stop, this is where you come. 🕊️

Three hours of gentle soaking worship instrumental — soft piano, warm
ambient pads, and Scripture on screen — for anxious nights, racing
thoughts, and the moments you can't carry alone.

Let it play while you pray. While you read. While you fall asleep.
You don't have to hold everything together for the next three hours.

"In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with
thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God,
which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts
in Christ Jesus." — Philippians 4:6-7

🕊️ No talking. Just His presence.
📖 All Scripture from the World English Bible
🎧 Best with headphones, at low volume

If God has placed it on your heart to support this ministry, you can leave a
donation at the "Buy me a Coffee" link below — Each donation helps us continue spreading God's word. 🙏

#soakingworship #prayermusic #christianmeditation

snippet.description:
🌿 Welcome to Enjoy Worship Moment 🤍

Every sunrise 🌅, every gentle breeze 🍃, every flowing river 🌊, and every birdsong 🕊️ declares the glory of our Creator. Through the beauty of nature, we are reminded of God's love, faithfulness, and everlasting presence.

At Enjoy Worship Moment, peaceful worship piano 🎹, inspiring Bible Scriptures 📖, and breathtaking landscapes 🌲 create a quiet place for prayer 🙏, worship, and resting in God's presence. May every video draw you closer to Jesus and fill your heart with His perfect peace.

We believe worship is more than music—it is a heart surrendered to God and a life devoted to His glory. May every melody strengthen your faith and lead you into His presence.

🤍 Thank you for being here. May Enjoy Worship Moment encourage your faith and remind you that God is always near.

🙏 May the Lord bless you and fill your heart with His everlasting peace.
